LanguageData.FCP_RailroadLiberation_Text: A Railroad contact has reached out about {0}. They won't say how they know, but they're certain {0} isn't entirely who {0} appears to be, and they'd rather make contact before anyone with worse intentions does.
LanguageData.FCP_RailroadLiberation_RevealText: The Railroad's suspicion was right. {0} is a synth, and probably never knew it. Whatever the Institute intended, the Railroad isn't interested in taking away the choice of who {0} gets to be from here.
